segments.sn9.12:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ aññataro bhikkhu kosalesu viharati aññatarasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe.
segments.sn9.12:1.2: Atha kho tasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe adhivatthā devatā yena so bhikkhu tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā tassa bhikkhuno santike imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi –
segments.sn9.12:2.1: “Ṭhite majjhanhike kāle, sannisīvesu [sannisinnesu (syā. kaṃ. pī.)] pakkhisu;
segments.sn9.12:2.3: Saṇateva brahāraññaṃ, taṃ bhayaṃ paṭibhāti maṃ.
segments.sn9.12:3.3: Saṇateva brahāraññaṃ, sā rati paṭibhāti man”ti.

lines: Dvādasame yaṃ vattabbaṃ, taṃ devatāsaṃyutte nandanavagge vuttameva.
Yadi evaṃ kasmā tattha saṅgītaṃ idha gahitanti?
Devatāpaṭisaṃyuttataṃ upādāya devatāsaṃyutte saṅgahitampi aṭṭhuppattiyā paṭisaṃyuttattā idha gahitaṃ.
